title: The Cradle and the Clock
lyrics:
The following song brings those voices together, weaving a message about the fleeting nature of time and the importance of being present.

(Verse 1: Harry Chapin – Acoustic guitar, rhythmic, story-teller voice)
I’ve walked the road where the clocks run fast,
Trading the present for the shadow of the past.
I’m telling you, friend, before the day is done,
Don’t let the calendar outrun your son.
The silver spoon is polished, but the cradle is cold,
If you wait for the future, you’ll just grow old.

(Verse 2: Stevie Nicks – Ethereal, steady beat, gentle piano)
It’s a landslide, watching the seasons turn,
And the lessons that come are the ones you have to earn.
Ruby and Wesley, they’re reaching for the light,
Hold on to the morning, let go of the night.
You can’t stop the turning, the shifting of the sand,
But you can hold onto the magic right here in your hand.

(Verse 3: Rodney Atkins – Upbeat, country-folk, honest grit)
It ain't just the words, it's the walk that you take,
Every prayer that you whisper, every promise you make.
They’re watching your shadow, they’re walking your line,
So make sure you’re present while you have the time.
It’s in the messy living, in the chaos and the play,
That’s where you find the life you’re trying to save today.

(Verse 4: Kenny Chesney – Warm, reflective, coastal acoustic vibe)
You think life is waiting for a better day,
But look in their eyes, don't look away.
That life you're building? It’s standing right there,
Not in the office, but in the love that you share.
You’re the hero of the story, you’re the rock in the sea,
Just be where you are, right here with me.

(Chorus: All Four – Harmonies blending, building to a crescendo)
So slow down the spin, let the world just fade,
It’s the moments at home where the memories are made.
Don’t wait for "someday" to be who you are,
You’ve got the universe right in your car.
The cradle is empty, the time is a ghost,
Love who you have, the ones that you love the most.

(Outro: All – Soft, fading out)
Be there for the morning...
Be there for the light...
For Ruby and Wesley...
Hold them tight.

(Verse 1: Harry Chapin – Acoustic guitar, rhythmic, story-teller voice)
I’ve walked the road where the clocks run fast,
Trading the present for the shadow of the past.
I’m telling you, friend, before the day is done,
Don’t let the calendar outrun your son.
The silver spoon is polished, but the cradle is cold,
If you wait for the future, you’ll just grow old.
And look at the faces, the joy in the air,
Ruby and Wesley, they're waiting right there.

(Verse 2: Stevie Nicks – Ethereal, steady beat, gentle piano)
It’s a landslide, watching the seasons turn,
And the lessons that come are the ones you have to earn.
Those little ones, they’re reaching for the light,
Hold on to the morning, let go of the night.
You can’t stop the turning, the shifting of the sand,
But you can hold onto the magic right here in your hand.
Let them be children, let the music play,
Don't let the best of them slip away.

(Verse 3: Rodney Atkins – Upbeat, country-folk, honest grit)
It ain't just the words, it's the walk that you take,
Every prayer that you whisper, every promise you make.
They’re watching your shadow, they’re walking your line,
So make sure you’re present while you have the time.
It’s in the messy living, in the chaos and the play,
That’s where you find the life you’re trying to save today.
Yeah, look at them now, they’re learning from you,
Everything you are, and everything you do.

(Verse 4: Kenny Chesney – Warm, reflective, coastal acoustic vibe)
You think life is waiting for a better day,
But look in their eyes, don't look away.
That life you're building? It’s standing right there,
Not in the office, but in the love that you share.
You’re the hero of the story, you’re the rock in the sea,
Just be where you are, right here with me.
Hold on to the laughter, the love you've found,
Keep your feet steady on the solid ground.

(Chorus: All Four – Harmonies blending, building to a crescendo)
So slow down the spin, let the world just fade,
It’s the moments at home where the memories are made.
Don’t wait for "someday" to be who you are,
You’ve got the universe right in your car.
The cradle is empty, the time is a ghost,
Love who you have, the ones that you love the most.

(Outro: All – Soft, fading out)
Be there for the morning...
Be there for the light...
For Ruby and Wesley...
Hold them tight.
